tooltip.tp_dragon_heart.dragons_heart_fi: Grants the Fire Dragon Blessing effect (ignites and knocks back targets)
Grants effect level 2 when also wearing the Fire Dragon's Eye
Grants effect level 3 when also wearing Dragonsteel Fire or Dreadsteel armor
tooltip.tp_dragon_heart.dragons_heart_ic: Grants the Ice Dragon Blessing effect (slows and freezes targets)
Grants effect level 2 when also wearing the Ice Dragon's Eye
Grants effect level 3 when also wearing Dragonsteel Ice or Dreadsteel armor
tooltip.tp_dragon_heart.dragons_heart_li: Grants the Lightning Dragon Protection effect (shocks and paralyzes targets)
Attacks all entities except the attacker
Grants effect level 2 when also wearing the Lightning Dragon's Eye
Grants effect level 3 when also wearing Dragonsteel Lightning or Dreadsteel armor
advancements.tp_dragon_heart.dragon_hear: Obtain any of the three Dragon's Hearts and make it beat again
Collect the Fire, Ice and Lightning Dragon's Hearts
